'''Em'Tora VII''' was the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of [[Coyn]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. As Queen, Em'Tora helped rule over the 29 [[Ag'Tra]], or noble families, and was married to [[En'Tra]] [[Im'Toral XV]].
